page.overview:
Who is Chuan?

At one point, Chuan began working as a firebending teacher at Sunray Academy. She earned a fearsome reputation for her martial abilities and skill as an instructor. Usually, she only taught students who had reached at least eighth grade. In contrast to her formidable reputation as a martial artist, Chuan was also infamous for her poor cooking skills, and once gave the entire staff of Sunray Academy food poisoning with her homemade noodles.

Four years after the national victory of the "Flame Throwers", Chuan was seeking new students for an upcoming regional tournament. She noticed that no firebending fifth graders were volunteering for the competition. Chuan thus organized a small demonstration for the fifth graders in one of Sunray Academy's training rooms, with a group of sixteen-year-old students battling and easily defeating a team of sixth graders. Afterward, she mounted the stage and addressed the eleven-year-old students in the audience, declaring her intention to form a team of fifth graders for the regional tournament. The audience was not enthused, as any volunteers would have to fight older students, a daunting prospect, as the previous demonstration had shown.

To make her idea more palatable, she announced that the regional competition offered a victory prize of one hundred gold pieces and her readiness to personally train the team of fifth graders. To Chuan's satisfaction, one young student, Adaki, promptly volunteered himself and his friends Jiyung, Aera, and Sujun.

For the first training session of Adaki's team, Chuan explained the rules of the tournament and gave inspiration to her young pupils. She revealed that the first lesson would be focused on math, asking who liked the subject. Only Jiyung responded positively, whereas Adaki, Aera, and Sujun were horrified. As start to the lesson, Chuan tasked the students to paint every angle she would call out at a regular pace. Yet this task overwhelmed all four students, with Jiyung being the only one who even managed to paint one correct angle. Yet Chuan declared that she had expected this outcome, requesting the four to discuss the exercise's meaning as she temporarily withdrew from the room.
